content.intro: In this lesson, you will work through using jquery with modern javascript with a focused jQuery example. The subtopics below preserve the supplied curriculum coverage and connect the API idea to a small browser interface.
content.why_it_matters: This topic is useful because it turns using const and let in jquery code into a repeatable implementation choice. jQuery Core is separate from jQuery UI and third-party plugins. Integrate it with server-rendered pages and modern JavaScript selectively, and avoid competing ownership of the same DOM subtree.

common_mistakes: Assuming a selector matched an element without checking the collection length.
Confusing jQuery collections with native DOM elements or live properties with markup attributes.
Using .html() with untrusted data or assuming client-side validation enforces server rules.
Treating a demo snippet as production-ready without testing failure and accessibility states.
